page.notes: Marginal notes are partly faint; the left-margin note "Novi illi Methodistæ caussa Pontificiæ proditores merito habentur" is set in three lines and is reproduced as one note. Bossuet note reads "Bossuet Condomiensis Episcopus". Greek words in the text are transcribed approximately: "Φηλώσι πνεύματι" (first word uncertain [?]) and "ἀνεξαγώνια" [?].
